#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <iomanip>

class InputHandler {
public:
    std::istream& source;
    std::vector<char> buffer;
    int cursor;
    int limit;

    InputHandler(std::istream& src) : source(src), buffer(1024), cursor(0), limit(0) {}

    int getInt() {
        int ch = fetch();
        while (isSpace(ch)) ch = fetch();
        int negative = 1;
        if (ch == '-') {
            negative = -1;
            ch = fetch();
        }
        int value = 0;
        do {
            if (ch < '0' || ch > '9') throw std::runtime_error("Input mismatch");
            value = value * 10 + (ch - '0');
            ch = fetch();
        } while (!isSpace(ch));
        return value * negative;
    }

private:
    int fetch() {
        if (limit == -1) throw std::runtime_error("Input mismatch");
        if (cursor >= limit) {
            cursor = 0;
            try {
                limit = source.readsome(&buffer[0], buffer.size());
            } catch (...) {
                throw std::runtime_error("Input mismatch");
            }
            if (limit <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return static_cast<unsigned char>(buffer[cursor++]);
    }

    bool isSpace(int ch) {
        return ch == ' ' || ch == '\n' || ch == '\r' || ch == '\t' || ch == -1;
    }
};

class Computator {
public:
    static const int CAPACITY = 1 << 20;
    static double realCos[CAPACITY];
    static double realSin[CAPACITY];
    static double imagCos[CAPACITY];
    static double imagSin[CAPACITY];

    Computator() {
        static bool initialized = false;
        if (!initialized) {
            for (int group = 1; group <= CAPACITY; group <<= 1) {
                int half = group >> 1;
                for (int i = half; i < group; i++) {
                    double angle = 2 * M_PI * (i - half) / group;
                    realCos[i] = cos(angle);
                    realSin[i] = sin(angle);
                    imagCos[i] = cos(-angle);
                    imagSin[i] = sin(-angle);
                }
            }
            initialized = true;
        }
    }

    void execute(int testId, InputHandler& reader, std::ostream& writer) {
        const int MOD = 998244353;
        int n = reader.getInt();
        int k = reader.getInt();
        std::vector<int> initial(10, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int idx = reader.getInt();
            initial[idx] = 1;
        }

        std::vector<int> product = {1};
        int exp = n / 2;

        while (true) {
            if (exp & 1) {
                product = combine(product, initial, MOD);
            }
            exp >>= 1;
            if (exp == 0) break;
            initial = combine(initial, initial, MOD);
        }

        long long total = 0;
        for (int val : product) {
            total += static_cast<long long>(val) * val;
        }
        writer << total % MOD << std::endl;
    }

private:
    std::vector<int> combine(const std::vector<int>& first, const std::vector<int>& second, int modulo) {
        int required = first.size() + second.size() - 1;
        int size = std::max(2, 1 << (32 - __builtin_clz(required - 1)));

        std::vector<double> re1(size, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> im1(size, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(first.size()); i++) {
            int val = ((first[i] % modulo) + modulo) % modulo;
            re1[i] = val & 0x7FFF;
            im1[i] = val >> 15;
        }
        transform(re1, im1, false);

        std::vector<double> re2(size, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> im2(size, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(second.size()); i++) {
            int val = ((second[i] % modulo) + modulo) % modulo;
            re2[i] = val & 0x7FFF;
            im2[i] = val >> 15;
        }
        transform(re2, im2, false);

        std::vector<double> reRes(size, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> imRes(size, 0.0);

        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            int j = (size - i) & (size - 1);
            double ar1 = (re1[i] + re1[j]) / 2;
            double ai1 = (im1[i] - im1[j]) / 2;
            double ar2 = (im1[i] + im1[j]) / 2;
            double ai2 = (re1[j] - re1[i]) / 2;

            double br1 = (re2[i] + re2[j]) / 2;
            double bi1 = (im2[i] - im2[j]) / 2;
            double br2 = (im2[i] + im2[j]) / 2;
            double bi2 = (re2[j] - re2[i]) / 2;

            reRes[i] = ar1 * br1 - ai1 * bi1 - ar2 * bi2 - ai2 * br2;
            imRes[i] = ar1 * bi1 + ai1 * br1 + ar2 * br2 - ai2 * bi2;
        }

        transform(reRes, imRes, true);
        std::vector<int> result(required);
        for (int i = 0; i < required; i++) {
            long long r1 = llround(reRes[i]);
            long long r2 = llround(imRes[i]);
            long long r3 = llround(imRes[size - i]);
            result[i] = static_cast<int>((r1 + ((r2 % modulo) << 15) + ((r3 % modulo) << 30)) % modulo);
        }
        return result;
    }

    void transform(std::vector<double>& re, std::vector<double>& im, bool inverse) {
        int n = re.size();
        int bits = 32 - __builtin_clz(n);
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int j = __builtin_bswap32(i << bits) >> bits;
            if (i < j) {
                std::swap(re[i], re[j]);
                std::swap(im[i], im[j]);
            }
        }

        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int mid = len >> 1;
            int step = CAPACITY / len;

            for (int start = 0; start < n; start += len) {
                for (int idx = 0, w = 0; idx < mid; idx++, w += step) {
                    double wRe = inverse ? imagCos[mid + idx] : realCos[mid + idx];
                    double wIm = inverse ? imagSin[mid + idx] : realSin[mid + idx];

                    int p = start + idx;
                    int q = start + idx + mid;

                    double uRe = re[p];
                    double uIm = im[p];
                    double vRe = re[q] * wRe - im[q] * wIm;
                    double vIm = re[q] * wIm + im[q] * wRe;

                    re[p] = uRe + vRe;
                    im[p] = uIm + vIm;
                    re[q] = uRe - vRe;
                    im[q] = uIm - vIm;
                }
            }
        }

        if (inverse) {
            double invN = 1.0 / n;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                re[i] *= invN;
                im[i] *= invN;
            }
        }
    }
};

double Computator::realCos[CAPACITY];
double Computator::realSin[CAPACITY];
double Computator::imagCos[CAPACITY];
double Computator::imagSin[CAPACITY];

int main() {
    InputHandler in(std::cin);
    Computator solver;
    solver.execute(1, in, std::cout);
    return 0;
}
